item.title: FAQ
item.description: Support Frequently Asked Questions Find answers to common questions about Sails CrossSecurities and our platform. General For Issuers For Investors Compliance Technical General Questions What is Sails.to? + Sails.to is a CrossSecurities infrastructure platform that bridges blockchain technology with traditional finance. We enable businesses to issue compliant CrossSecurities that can be held either on-chain on the Solana blockchain or CrossConverted to bankable securities with an ISIN for custody at institutions like Clearstream.

item.title: Getting Started with Sails.to
item.description: ← Back to Knowledge Base Guide Getting Started with Sails.to Complete onboarding guide for issuers, investors, and brokers In This Guide Platform Overview For Issuers For Investors For Brokers Verification Process Getting Help Platform Overview Sails.to is a compliant platform for issuing, investing in, and distributing security tokens. We combine blockchain efficiency with traditional finance compliance to offer the best of both worlds. What We Offer Issuers: Tokenize assets, raise capital globally, manage cap tables automatically Investors: Access curated offerings, choose your custody model, receive automated distributions Brokers: Expand your product offering, earn competitive commissions, serve global clients Key Features Compliant by design: Reg D 506(c) / Reg S framework with full KYC/AML Hybrid custody: Self-custody on Solana or institutional via Clearstream Wyoming DAO LLC: Legal entity recognition with Series LLC protection Secondary trading: Compliant peer-to-peer transfers For Issuers Launch a tokenized securities offering in weeks, not months.

item.title: Wyoming DAO LLC Explained
item.description: ← Back to Knowledge Base Guide Wyoming DAO LLC Explained Understanding the legal structure behind compliant tokenized securities In This Guide What Is a Wyoming DAO LLC? Why Wyoming? The Series LLC Advantage How It Works at Sails.to Investor Rights & Protections Governance & Voting DAO LLC vs. Traditional Structures What Is a Wyoming DAO LLC? A Wyoming DAO LLC is a limited liability company that can be managed algorithmically—through smart contracts instead of (or in addition to) human managers.
